answer: Because your offer was issued before February 1, 2026, it keeps the original terms of 7 days or 300 additional miles, whichever comes first, rather than the new 5-day limit. We honor the offer as long as your appraisal appointment is on or before the expiration date, which is shown on your offer page and in your confirmation email. Seven days from January 28 points to around February 4, but check that exact date and make sure you haven't driven 300 or more additional miles. If the offer has expired, you can request a new one at any time, though the amount will reflect current market prices and may be higher or lower.
